about: Which VPS runners take the heavy jobs: the pull request and main build fallbacks, the engine fallback and the nightly checks. Each of those jobs asks for this label beside thornswood-vps, so no more of them run at once than there are runners carrying it. Every other job on the box (board cards, dropped claims, the release jobs) still runs on any VPS runner. scripts/deploy/Set-BuildRunners.ps1 makes GitHub's runner labels match this file, and Install-Runner.ps1 registers a runner in this list with the label. Issue #2994.
label: thornswood-build
measured: 22 Oct 2026, after the gate went side by side (#3114, #3125, #3190): one build's gate now needs about 1,475 s of processor (PR #3190's build, 737 s on the clock with six at a time), so two builds fill the box's six cores by themselves. At four at once on 21 Oct the box sat 99.9% busy and each gate got what it could grab: #3106's build at 519b986 had 1,472 s of processor in 1,592 s, under one core, and 30 of its harnesses never started inside its 1,800 s, while #3190's beside it had 1,475 s in 737 s. A box that is busy either way cannot finish more builds an hour with four at once than with two; four only makes each one slower, past its time. With two, each gate has about three cores for its 1,475 s, near 8 minutes by that arithmetic (to be measured once it runs), and the others wait in GitHub's queue, which has no time limit. Before 22 Oct, when a gate ran one harness at a time: measured 21 Oct 2026 over the 558 box jobs that ran a harness step from 18 Oct to 04:30Z 21 Oct, a whole job took a median 18 min with 1 or 2 at once, 20.4 with 3, 21.7 with 4, 26.1 with 5, 31.7 with 6 and 36.2 with 7, and the box finished 3.4, 6.7, 8.8, 11.1, 11.5, 11.3 and 11.6 jobs an hour.
added: 26 Oct 2026, 5:40 PM: runner 4 added as a third build runner on Patrick's C on q-desk-maint-servers-down, with both game servers and both voice servers stopped for the maintenance hour. Measured just before (Cloud Desk): box CPU 93% with two builds, the game servers about 0.1 CPU s in a 20 s sample, 8.6 of 16 GB free, 11 builds queued. Whether three raise builds an hour over two with the side by side gate is to be measured on this queue; #3835 measures what Defender takes.
